title: Nubby's Number Factory
notes: Tested on both r19 and r25, launched through Steam with Proton-ish 0.1.0-beta.5 (a NotProton fork that runs Highball's engine as a Steam Play tool), not the Highball app. The occasional stutter was never a problem in practice, since the game is very passive (click and wait).
issues: A few times some lag/stuttering with no apparent cause; about 95% of the time it runs perfectly.
